TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Ice activated flag
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: This float type is equiped with Ice detection algorithm which needs to be activated (before launch or at any time during the mission): reported flag = 1 when Ice detection algorithm is activated for the concerned cycle, = 0 otherwise.

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Deep cycle transmission flag
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: Reported flag = 1 when the concerned transmission session occured after a deep cycle (i.e. a subsurface) one, = 0 when the float is programed to stay at the surface before the concerned transmission session.

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Transmission mode (not delayed, trans delayed, ice delayed)
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: When the float is not able to transmit the cycle data in real time, the transmission of (part or all of) the data is delayed. Reported flag = 0 when all the cycle data have been transmitted in real time (i.e. during the transmission session of the same cycle), = 1 when the float didn't surface because of ice detection (all cycle data are stored until next transmission session), = 2 when some data transmission has been delayed due to transmission issue (after fail of first transmission attemps data was stored until next transmission session),.

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Buffer completness
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: Before processing the received data, the decoder checks that all expected data has been received. If not, it waits for following transmission sessions. Finally, if after a given number (decoder configuration parameter) of transmission sessions, missing data still remain, the cycle data are decoder. Reported flag = 1 if all expected cycle data have been received, = 0 otherwise.

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: ISA detection by ICE algorithm

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Hanging detection by ICE algorithm
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: Alarm raised when Ice has been detected with a collision (float hanging).

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Ascent aborted by ICE algorithm because in breakup period
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: Alarm raised when the float is still not surfacing (even without Ice detection) due to Ice advoidance algorithm.

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Forced ascent
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: Alarm raised when irrespective of other tests (e.g. ISA), the ice algorithm forced ascent to the surface.

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Sat_mask detection by ICE algorithm
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: Alarm raised when Ice has been detected with the satellite mask.

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Ice algo profile aborted
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: Alarm raised when the profile has been aborted by Ice detection.

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Abort pressure (min PRES meas available)
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: Pressure when float avoids ice

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Last 8 profiles aborted flags
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: aborted profile count - increments by one for each profile interrupted by ice detection. If units are 'bit' then represents the ice evasion record for the last 8 profiles with the latest profile in the least significant bit.

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Digest of ICE information
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: ICE information digest: 11 bits information with, from LSB to MSB: bit#1: Transmission flag (the float succeeded to reach the GPS or Iridium satellites), #2: ICE algorithm activated flag (the ICE algorithm is enabled and switched on), #3: ICE surface avoidance flag (the ICE algorithm is able to act on float behavior), #4: Aborted profile flag (the ICE algorithm aborted the ascending profile), #5: ISA flag (the result of ISA check), #6: Breakup period flag (the ascending profile occured during the breakup period), #7: Hanging flag (the ICE algorithm detected a float hanging), #8: Satellite mask flag (the ICE algorithm detected that the float tried but failed to reach the GPS or Iridium satellites constellations), #9: Forced ascent flag (the ascending profile was forced to try to reach the surface), #10: AC1 activated flag (the AC1 (PROVOR_IV float) feature is activated), #11: ICE cycle performed flag (the (Apex APF11) float used at least one ICE cycle after the ascending profile).

TECH_PARAM_MSG_LABEL: Pressure sensor offset (not sampled at the surface)
TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: Pressure offset not necessarily sampled at the surface but originally used to correct PRES data provided by the float (copy of PRES_SurfaceOffsetCorrectedNotResetNegative_1cBarResolution_dbar in case of erroneous resetoffset).
